We assume half the market requires rear glass because—while dc more than half of U.S. c-Si demand in 2024 was for bifacial modules—U.S. PV module assembly has historically focused on monofacial modules for the higher-priced residential PV market. We also assume the 6.3 GW of CdTe dc modules produced in the United States during 2024 used imported rolled glass as the rear cover glass. 32 The HTS code that includes PV cover glass (7007.19.0000) also includes glass for non-PV applications and is described as “toughened (tempered) safety glass, other than that of a size and shape suitable for incorporation in vehicles, aircraft, spacecraft, or vessels.” 47 This report is available at no cost from the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) at www.nlr.gov/publications. The U.S. import data do not directly indicate how much rolled glass was imported for PV, but some analysis is possible from rate provision codes.33 Tempered glass with antireflective coating for PV modules is exempt from Section 301 tariffs if the area is less than 2.5 m2 (U.S. Trade Representative 2024a). As shown in Figure 34, tempered glass imports from China only represented about 80% of U.S. demand for rolled glass for c-Si PV modules assembled in the United States, before accounting for demand from glass applications other than PV. Thus, either significant amounts of PV front glass were imported from countries other than China, or some PV front glass was not tempered or heat strengthened sufficiently to be included under HTS number 7007 (Palmiotti et al. 2025). Figure 34. Tempered glass imports from China into the United States during 2024. Source: (US ITC, n.d.) for 7007.19.0000 Figure 35 shows the total area of U.S. tempered glass imports by country. Total U.S. imports from China, Malaysia, and Vietnam approach 67 million m2, while the total of all remaining countries only approached 2 million m2. As mentioned earlier in this section, about 46 million m2 of rolled glass were needed for c-Si module assembly in the United States during 2024. This indicates that PV applications may account for the majority (69%) of glass reported under HTS number 7007.19.0000. Malaysia and Vietnam are the only countries other than China that supplied more than 1 million m2 to the United States in 2024 (29 million m2 in total). This indicates these countries likely provided a significant amount of front glass needed for 2024 module assembly in the United States, as indicated by the gap between market size and imports for rate provision code 79 in Figure 34. 33 Because glass for PV with antireflective coatings is exempt from Section 301 tariffs, imports of PV front glass are probably reported within the rate provision code “79 - dutiable, no duty reported” segment, along with the value of the only other Section 301 exemption for this HTS code, which covers screen protectors.
